confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for July peak season. Restaurant anchors (beer, coffee, meals, wine) are moderately reliable. Hostel and hotel anchors are the least certain because summer rates vary widely by booking date and property. Cocktail and wine are inferred from the local beer relationship, since direct knowledge of those prices is weaker. No live listings or booking pages were checked. The FX observation is taken from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates overview; the RBA page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked to Naples and Amalfi Coast tourist-zone pricing, adjusted upward for July resort-season demand. Sorrento is assumed to sit below Positano and Capri but above Naples' non-tourist districts.
